title: Three beautiful locations of Spain
text:
Great way to experience three stunning places in a short space of time. Very knowledgeable, friendly and enthusiastic guides (Antonio and Enrique)
Really enjoyed and glad we booked.
Just plan ahead as there were no bathroom facilities on our tour bus and the journeys at thier longest were a couple of hours.
author: matnjira

title: A happy day, but with some regrets.
text:
This day was very rewarding. The tour guides Enrique and Antonio are very interesting and patient in taking care of each member. Every time you go to a place, they will give you some tips for the game.
It is a shame that the weather did not cooperate today; it drizzled the whole time. When we arrived in Ronda, it was already night. I would like to return in the summer if I have the opportunity.
author: Curious46337916707

title: Best way to see three cities in a day
text: We had a fantastic time, it’s a best way to see three cities in a day. Antonio and Enrique were very good and it’s a well guided tour, highly recommend it.
